title: Archive members
description: The members of a COFF archive (a .lib): what a link can pull in, and which compiler built each object. An archive is not a program, so it has no sections, functions or addresses; what it carries is a bill of materials.

file.description: Path of the archive as it was given.

sha256.description: Digest of the whole archive, not of any member.

members.description: One entry per member, in the order they appear in the file.

name.description: The member's name, with the long-name table resolved.

raw_name.description: The name exactly as the member header spells it.

offset.description: File offset of the member's contents.

size.description: Size of the member's contents in bytes.

date.description: The archive header's date field: a Unix timestamp.

machine.description: For an object or import member: the machine the COFF header names.

timestamp.description: For an object: the COFF header's TimeDateStamp.

comp_id.description: For an object that carries one: the raw @comp.id value, (product id << 16) | build.

comp_tool.description: The product id from comp_id, named from the Rich header's table.

symbols.description: The object's own symbols, excluding the compiler's bookkeeping ones.

import_dll.description: For an import member: the DLL the symbol comes from.

import_symbol.description: For an import member: the symbol the DLL exports.

import_ordinal.description: For an import member that imports by number: the ordinal.

describe.description: One line saying what the member is, in words rather than fields.

objects.description: Members holding COFF objects: the ones a link pulls code from.

imports.description: Short import members: records naming a DLL and a symbol.

compilers.description: Every compiler the objects name, most-built first, with the object count.

imported_dlls.description: The distinct DLLs the import members point at.

problems.description: What could not be read, said out loud rather than dropped.
